qc.clearBody: Select a newer passing run for the same instrument and analyte and document the corrective action.
qc.clearPlaceholder: e.g. recalibrated, reran control, within limits
qc.needPassingRun: No newer passing run yet: record one first.
qc.rulesNote: Rule set and warning/rejection policy await pathologist sign-off.

qc.sub: Control runs, Westgard rules and blocks
qc.title: Quality control

ruleText.1_2s: One control beyond 2 SD: warning only.
ruleText.2_2s: Two consecutive controls beyond 2 SD on the same side: reject.
ruleText.R_4s: Range between controls exceeds 4 SD in one run: reject.
ruleText.4_1s: Four consecutive controls beyond 1 SD on the same side: reject.
ruleText.10x: Ten consecutive controls on the same side of the mean: reject.

release.guardNote: A report can only be signed when every result is validated, covered by passing QC and signed by an authorised signatory. Each channel needs patient consent.
release.sub: Sign validated reports and release them on consented channels.
release.title: Release

crit.ackBody: Confirm that the ordering clinician has been informed.
crit.signoffNote: Limits and acknowledgement windows need pathologist sign-off. Escalation cannot be switched off.
crit.sub: Critical results must be acknowledged within the configured window or they escalate.
crit.title: Critical values
